title: 21-year-old man stabbed steps away from St. Patrick’s Cathedral and Saks Fifth Avenue: cops
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A 21-year-old man was stabbed just steps away from St. Patrick’s Cathedral and Saks Fifth Avenue during a Monday evening Midtown clash with a BMW driver who nearly struck him, cops and sources said.

The victim – who was on foot – was nearly hit by the driver at West 50th Street and Fifth Avenue around 7:30 p.m. and started arguing with him, according to law enforcement sources.

The heated argument boiled over when the assailant knifed the man in the arm and torso, police said.

The jabber then took off in the black Beemer and has not been caught, cops said.

EMS rushed to the scene and took the man to Bellevue Hospital, where he was listed in stable condition.

No arrests have been made, and the investigation was ongoing, according to police.

The attack happened just hours after Pamela Cisneros, 49, randomly knifed a man and a woman less than a block away at West 41st Street and Seventh Avenue, police said.

Cisneros killed the 32-year-old woman and critically injured the 68-year-old man in a 20-second span before she was shot and killed by police, cops said.
